results.title: Disha Salian's father serves ₹500cr defamation notice to Aaditya Thackeray
results.description: Satish Salian, the father of late celebrity manager Disha Salian, has served a defamation notice of ₹500 crore to Shiv Sena-UBT leader Aaditya Thackeray, reported IANS.

results.title: Tigmanshu Dhulia claims love stories are 'not worth making'
results.description: Filmmaker-actor Tigmanshu Dhulia, known for his gritty plots, has ruled out the possibility of directing an urban love story.

results.title: Hilary Duff Reveals Secret Skincare Routine That Keeps Her Glow Radiant on Stage
results.description: Hilary Duff's makeup professional Taylor Healey discloses the star's pre‐makeup regimen of a lightweight antioxidant moisturizer, gentle exfoliating microfoliant, and hydrating base that keeps her complexion vivid even under unforgiving stage lights. Fans can now reproduce the routine for a flawless, natural glow.
